VI.description: Shares a WINDOW of any process in a web browser - a front panel of another LabVIEW (a built application or another LabVIEW version)\2C or a window of any other program - and returns immediately. window is its handle (HWND)\3B RemoteVI Server lists the windows that can be shared. Everything else is as RemoteVI Start.vi\3A URL is the link with the access token\2C this computer only unless whole network? is TRUE\2C token empty makes a random one\2C view only? ignores the browsers' input\2C one share per port. A window target is streamed and operated through Win32 only\3A the picture\2C clicks\2C keys\2C menus and popups\2C and the dialogs and other windows of its process\3B tip strips and splitter dragging need the VI's own LabVIEW (VI Server) and are not available\2C and Shift\2C Ctrl and Alt reach another process only in the mouse messages' flags (docs\5Carchitecture.md). The share stops on RemoteVI Stop.vi with the same port\2C or by itself when the window is closed.

Control.description: Most frames per second sent to a client.
FALSE (default)\3A reachable from this computer only. TRUE\3A listens on every interface.
The access token the link carries. Empty (default)\3A a new random token.
TRUE\3A the browsers see the window but cannot operate it.

How to reach the window's LabVIEW over VI Server for full features (Shift\2C Ctrl and Alt\2C tip strips\2C splitter bars - docs\5Csecurity.md). Empty (default)\3A from the application's INI file (server.tcp.enabled=True\2C server.tcp.port)\3B off\3A window only\3B host\3Aport\3A that VI Server. RemoteVI Status.vi tells which mode a share got (kind VI Server or Window).
Standard error in. Nothing is started on an incoming error.

Indicator.description: The share's link with its access token.
As RemoteVI Start.vi\3A 5001 when this port is already shared here\2C the listener error (e.g. 60)\2C 5002\2C 5003.
